primarySource.title: ＝LOVE 21st single official music video
primarySource.sourceNote: Canonical profile content is transcribed from the English character cards shown in the official music video. A user-supplied 2×5 composite was used only as a transcription aid after its text was checked against those cards; the composite file is not an official release asset and is not included in this product.

archetype-21-anna.sourceFlagNote: The five displayed components sum to 2450, while the same card displays Total 2550. Both the components and displayed total are preserved verbatim.

editorialRules: DATE OF JOINING is stored and localized as 加入日期, never as a member number.
Displayed RPG-style stats are source transcription only and never shape role fingerprints.
Each role fingerprint uses the frozen eight dimensions with exactly two scores of 2, one score of 1, and five scores of 0.
Fingerprint judgments use only the card title, class, profile, and weapon text; they do not claim to describe the real member's personality.
No card image or user-supplied composite is shipped as a product asset.
